metabolic_screening.label: Newborn Metabolic Screening (blood spot / PKU)
metabolic_screening.program: New Jersey Newborn Screening and Genetic Services — Division of Family Health Services
metabolic_screening.state_form_note: N.J.S.A. 26:2-110 et seq. — screening is required for all newborns; religious exemption under N.J.A.C. 8:18-1.12 on grounds of religious tenets or practices. No standalone parent declination form — refusal is documented in the NJ birth certificate system (VERI) and on the NBS-TRF.
metabolic_screening.kit_ordering_note: TRF supplies ordered through NJ DHSS; specimens shipped to NJ Public Health and Environmental Laboratories; VERI registration required.
metabolic_screening.specimen_tracking_note: NBS tracking via NJ birth certificate system (VERI); midwives verify specimen receipt through the state lab.
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Complete TRF 12–48h after birth, register in VERI, keep copy, give to parents, send specimen to NJ lab.
metabolic_screening.declination_law: N.J.S.A. 26:2-110; N.J.A.C. 8:18-1.12 — religious exemption documented on TRF and in VERI.

billing.note: Parents are billed directly; most insurance covers screening; midwife is NOT billed for the screening test itself.

hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening
hearing_screening.program: New Jersey Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program
hearing_screening.state_form_note: NJ hearing screening law: 'no newborn child shall be screened for hearing loss if the parent of the newborn objects to such screening on the grounds that the screening conflicts with the parents' bona fide religious tenets or practices.' Refusal documented in VERI on the newborn screening tab.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Educate parents; if opted-in, refer to EHDI-approved audiologist; if declined, document refusal in VERI.

cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening (critical congenital heart disease)
cchd_screening.program: NJ Division of Family Health Services — Birth Defects Registry
cchd_screening.state_form_note: CCHD screening is part of the NBS panel; refusal documented in VERI and on TRF; no standalone state form.
cchd_screening.midwife_role: Perform or refer for pulse-ox screening; submit results per NBS TRF packet; document refusal in VERI if declined.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: Eye prophylaxis is a standard of care; no standalone state declination form — practice standard is a signed informed-refusal/waiver document (app master form).
erythromycin_eye_ointment.midwife_role: If opted-in: administer erythromycin within 2h of birth. If declined: signed informed refusal (in-app master form) retained in records.

vitamin_k.label: Vitamin K (oral or injection)
vitamin_k.midwife_role: Three-way informed choice (oral / shot / none) documented in-app; shot administered by midwife or referred.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine (birth dose)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.midwife_role: Birth-dose consent or declination documented in writing; administered dose reported to NJIIS.

gestational_diabetes.label: Gestational Diabetes Screening (prenatal)
gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice; midwife refers out for glucose testing when declined.

group_b_strep.label: Group B Strep Screening & Prophylaxis (prenatal)
group_b_strep.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice per ACOG/CDC; swab testing via referral or in-office; intrapartum antibiotics referred if opted-in.
